answer: Depth-scored web-of-trust at the vine: each attestation adds one edge, and trust weight decays with graph distance, so a sybil cluster must forge a chain of independent vouches. The trellis enforces that no single identity contributes more than one edge per depth layer. Fabricating depth d costs d distinct aged identities with real history; the whisper of a purchased farm collapses at depth 3 since edge cost grows superlinearly. Sybils cannot fake organic trust depth without paying more than the reward, so the mechanism holds.
